SMTO-JOB-0008 — SMTO asked for job output in the wrong way

GUID: 772cf5dc-4dd8-466a-acdb-2ed2daf00311
Slug: job-log-window-invalid
Domain: JOB · Subsystem: job

What happened

  • SMTO tried to read part of a background job's output but phrased the request incorrectly. Nothing was changed, and SMTO usually corrects this on its next step.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait a moment and let the task continue. This was a small mistake in how SMTO asked for output, and it usually tries again correctly on its own.
  2. If you want to see the job's output now, open Inspect execution in the conversation. It shows the job's latest output without asking the job to do anything.
  3. If the task stops here, ask SMTO in the conversation to show the latest output of the background job. A plain request gives SMTO a fresh chance to ask for the output correctly.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows the job's output or status and the task carries on.

If it still fails

  • If the same message keeps appearing, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • manage_job received offset or limit for an action where they do not apply (offset is valid only for logs and output waits; limit only for logs).

What this means

  • manage_job receives offset or limit for an action other than logs. Job identity, supervision and dispatch/terminal receipts own effect truth. Diagnostics do not launch, cancel or replay work; missing output or failed control does not prove that the original process stopped.

Why this can happen

  • manage_job receives offset or limit for an action other than logs.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the chosen job action and remove paging fields from inspect/reconcile/control requests.

How to fix it

  • manage_job (agent_runtime/native/jobs.py) accepts offset only with action=logs or action=wait with until=output, and limit only with action=logs. Omit both for inspect, reconcile, cancel and other actions.
  • Use offset and limit only with action=logs. For other job actions, omit those pagination fields.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Paging fields appear only on valid bounded logs requests.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Job identity, supervision and dispatch/terminal receipts own effect truth. Diagnostics do not launch, cancel or replay work; missing output or failed control does not prove that the original process stopped.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
